_comment: CROSS Wave-3 (2026-05-19) — default runtime language-architecture config applied by brain_daemon.py after every brain create/load. Every flag below is RUNTIME-ONLY in the C library (not persisted in nimcp_brain_save). This file is the source of truth for how the cascade behaves on daemon start. Override per-deployment by placing a JSON at /etc/athena/runtime_lang_config.json or pointing the LANG_CONFIG env var at an alternate file. Set LANG_CONFIG=off to skip the apply entirely.
_slice_1: iterative cascade convergence — orchestrator only, no flag here; max_iters is per-call
_slice_2_arcuate: Wernicke<->Broca arcuate feedback. No public setter on this branch (lives on brain->arcuate_feedback_strength, written only by the recurrent loop itself). Listed here for documentation.
_deprecated_option1_rebuild: trigram_learning_enabled / ltd_margin / comprehend_stdp_enabled / da_modulation_enabled / da_modulation_gain were removed when the SNN-language bridge became transport-only (Option-1 rebuild, 2026-05-19). The daemon no longer applies them (not in _apply_runtime_lang_config) and their RPC handlers return 'deprecated'. Dropped from this file (walkthrough R3, 2026-05-27) so they no longer imply active tuning.
_slice_4_lateral_inhibition: K-WTA over lexical cohort. Default ON with divisive-norm tunables p=2.0 (gain_self repurposed as exponent) and eps=1e-6 (gain_inhibit repurposed as denominator floor). See S4-C1 in cascade.c.
_slice_5_phonological_loop: Baddeley working-memory phonological store + articulatory rehearsal. Default ON with biologically-reasonable decay/threshold.
_slice_6_thalamic_gates: Per-stage pulvinar-style gain. Default ON; the recurrent loop computes weights from arousal+attention each cascade run. Manual overrides via thalamic_gate_overrides{stage_idx: weight}.
_slice_7_cerebellar_correction: Predict + climbing-fiber LTD via existing cerebellum adapter. Default OFF until forward-model has had enough training to clear the confidence>0.3 gate (S7-H2). Operators flip on once cereb_motor_confidence stabilizes >0.3 in lang_status.
_produce_and_nlp_flags: Default-OFF developmental features (walkthrough R1/R2, 2026-05-27). Previously absent from this file, so they had no enable knob on the pod (the daemon's _apply_runtime_lang_config skips absent keys). Listed here at their current default (false) so an operator can flip them on per-deployment via /etc/athena/runtime_lang_config.json. reason_in_content is Tier-1 Step E; the produce_* trio is Tier-2 coherence; coref/subword are NLP-2/NLP-1. All re-applied from this file every daemon start (runtime-only, not in the checkpoint).
